rule: draft-zambo-aer1-26, Section 3.1: the canonical metadata block is a JSON object with exactly the members created_at, id, output_hash, provenance_class, receipt_schema_version, and tool (an object with exactly name, scope, version). Member names are sorted by Unicode code point at every object level, including nested objects; there is no whitespace outside strings; string escaping follows Section 7.1; every member value is a JSON string. metadata_hash is "sha256:" plus the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 encoding of that block. Section 6, step 4 makes the recompute mandatory for schema 0.4: a mismatch MUST cause verification to fail.

member_mapping.created_at: the receipt's creation time. Zambo's deployed receipts carry it in the timestamp member (Section 6 names timestamp as the carrier of the creation time when created_at is absent).
member_mapping.tool: the receipt's tool triple: the tool_context member, holding exactly name, scope, version.
